The Weibull two-parameter distribution function is fitted to the measured probability distributions on a monthly basis. The results of this study shows that the Weibull distribution function give an excellent fit to the wind speed distribution and the wind potential of Fujian province is not as optimistic as we expected previously.

articleTitle: Optimum feed-forward control for UPFC converters in large-scale non-grid-connected wind power applications
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: The three-phase PWM rectifier is one of the core techniques applied in large scale wind power system. DC-bus voltage usually fluctuates as the variation of load and ac voltage, which may hurt the safety and reliability of the system. In order to restrain dc-bus voltage fluctuation and improve system dynamic response, a direct current control and dual close loop control structure in d-q synchronous reference frame are employed. By analyzing the factors which influence the fast transient response, an optimum feed-forward control strategy is proposed based on the power balance relationship between the input and output of rectifier. With this control, the dc-bus voltage is immunized from not only variation of load but also variation of grid voltage, and the capacitance of the dc link capacitors can be reduced at same transient response demand of system. Simulation results show that the proposed control scheme has satisfactory steady-state characteristics and fast transient response.

articleTitle: Non-grid-connected wind power generating system with permanent magnet synchronous generator and buck/boost converter
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: In this paper, a distributed generation wind energy conversion system based on non-grid-connected and using a direct-drive permanent magnet synchronous generator (DD-PMSG) is proposed with a dual-loop PI controller. This energy system is suitable for applications in remote areas not connected to the grid such as Radio Base Stations (RBS) for mobile phone communications. Analysis, simulation, and prototyping test results are presented.

articleTitle: A study on the exploitation of wind energy and the development of the non-grid-connected wind power industry in central China
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: Based on the analysis of the exploitable wind energy reserves, the current status of wind energy exploitation as well as the problems in the development of wind power industry, this paper gives out the targets for the development of non-grid-connected wind power. Although there are abundant wind energy reserves that can be exploited in central China, the wind power industry is still in its early stage at present; therefore, scientific objectives for the exploitation of wind energy and non-grid-connected wind power industry need to be set up. The construction of wind power plants is required to be strengthened in regions with abundant wind energy reserves, and the clusters of non-grid-connected wind power industry per province also needs to be established. To achieve the above goals, great effort should be made so that the wind power industry can step into a new booming period.

articleTitle: Development of a non-grid-connected wind power industry in the urban agglomerations of the Pearl River Delta in China
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: The Pearl River Delta region is one of the important areas where wind energy resources best match conditions for development of a non-grid-connected wind power industry in China. Fully exploiting the onshore and offshore wind energy resources and developing large-scale a non-grid-connected wind power industry in the Pearl River Delta region cannot only promote regional sustainable development, but also can provide a model for the coastal areas and the whole country. Consequently, we explored the development foundation for non-grid-connected wind power industry in the Pearl River Delta region. Based on analysis of the current situation, we put forward some development goals, i.e., the total installed capacity of wind power in the Pearl River Delta region will reach 10 million kilowatts in 2020, and the proportion of non-grid-connected wind power to the total will be 30%. Subsequently, we put forward a tentative plan for constructing a national industrial base for a large-scale non-grid-connected wind power industry and a national industrial base for a high-energy, low-coal-consumption industry in the Pearl River Delta region. The core area of the Pearl River Delta region will become a national wind power equipment manufacturing center. The eastern and western areas along the coastland will become two national wind power bases, and the coastal area of the Pearl River Delta region will become a national development center for a high-energy, low-coal-consumption industry.

articleTitle: HER activity in alkaline medium of Ni-Mo-W alloys prepared by pulse plating
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: The impact of different electrodeposition conditions in pulse plating process on the composition, apparent morphology and HER (hydrogen evolution reaction) activity of Ni-Mo-W coating was investigated. The molybdenum content in the coating increases with the addition of molybdenum salt until to a constant value (about 39.0 wt %), while the corresponding HER overpotential decreases to the minimum value. The Ni-Mo-W coating with amorphous structure (c.a. 39.0 wt% Mo) prepared by pulse plating is smooth without cracks; moreover, it shows a good activity (353 K ， η<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">200</inf> = 3D62 mV) e. After galvanostatic electrolysis for 100 h in 33 wt% NaOH solution, the amorphous structure was destroyed due to the dissolution of Mo, however, the bubble phenomenon did not happen, which shows the higher stability and corrosion resistance.

articleTitle: Response spectrum analysis of wind turbine with joint action of wind and wave
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: The single degree of freedom offshore wind turbine system load model is analyzed and calculated by adopting the single degree of freedom linear system response power spectrum method. Some results, including the vibration velocity spectrum, the acceleration spectrum, the shear spectrum of tower bottom, and the moment spectrum, are obtained. Through the analysis of the response spectrum, it is found that the sheer force and the response of moment of the tower bottom are not only dependent on the aerodynamic load spectrum and the wave force spectrum, but are also determined by the natural frequency of the system and the damping ratio. It also does not lay directly on the equivalent mass of the system and the equivalent stiffness. So, it can be deduced that the natural frequency of the system and damping ratios are decisive in the design of the tower frame and foundation.

articleTitle: Daily diffuse solar radiation at Beijing
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: In order to obtain reliable radiation for design, operation and economic assessment of solar energy conversion device, a statistical analysis of daily correlations between diffuse solar radiation and global solar radiation is carried out using 10yr data (1995-2004) of daily global and diffuse solar radiation obtained at Beijing meteorological station of China. The accuracy of the correlations is performed in terms of the coefficient of determination, R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The results indicate that the correlations relating the diffuse fraction (K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</sub>) with the clearness index (K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</sub>) are reliable for diffuse radiation prediction at Beijing, China. And the quadratic model of the whole period is preferred for both its accuracy and its simplicity.

articleTitle: Developing large scale non-grid-connected wind power by implementing “Seawater Forwarding Westward” strategy
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: Seawater Forwarding Westwardrdquo is a significant way to implement the strategy of the development of West China. It is also a strategic idea to radically solve desertification and sand storm in northwest drought region like Inner Mongolia. This makes us long for the beautiful and rich future of northwest region. However, the key of implementation of this great strategy is to use technology that can utilize green renewable energy sources as its primary productive force for the support. Hereby, this paper proposes to combine wind power and ldquoSeawater Forwarding Westwardrdquo together by applying large-scale non-grid-connected wind power technology, which will directly drive several DC-conversion of large high-pressure pumps and transport seawater of 20 billion -30 billion cubic meters per year to the west through pipe culverts. By using rich wind resources in the water transmission line that contributes to the exploration of a new road to industrialization in western China, the non-grid-connected wind power will enable the building of several pressure stations and green heavy chemical bases on seawater desalination, chlor-alkali, nonferrous metallurgy, and coal-based energy industry.

articleTitle: Core loss analysis on multi-pole-rotor doubly salient electro-magnetic wind generator
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: Wind generator has a typical characteristic of more pole-pairs number on the occasion of low speed and high power, and DSEG should adopt multi-pole-rotor structure for the corresponding relation of pole-pairs number and rotor pole number. The increase of rotor-pole number leads to the obvious increase of core loss. Flux waveform of different part of 24-32-DSEG is analyzed in this paper, and core loss FE calculation and analysis is made by iron loss separate model. Then core loss distribution in rated operation point and the core loss with different load is obtained. In closing the core loss change law with no-load and different load is summarized, and the explanation for the law is given through the analysis.

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling of the nickel electrode for the single flow zinc-nickel battery
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: In this paper, a mathematical model of nickel electrode for single flow zinc-nickel battery is developed based on the previous models. Diffusion and migration in the electrolyte phase as well as proton diffusion and ohmic drop through the solid active material in the porous nickel electrode are all taken into account in this model. The most complicated segments, such as the beginning segment of charge process in which the diffusion does not reach steady state, can also be simulated using this model.

articleTitle: An image on architecture of non-grid-connected wind system based on DC transmission
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: In this paper, the structure that could be applied for the power transmission in non-grid-connected wind power system is proposed. The power transmission system consists of several voltage source converters (VSC) in parallel. The wind power is connected to the high voltage DC lines in Distributed manner, and converted to low voltage by the dc/dc converters in the reception end of the grid. Finally, the wind power is used by those high-energy-cost enterprises, such as the of electrolytic aluminum production factory. In this paper, the structure of grid-connected in wind plants are analyzed and compared. Then the structure that could be applied to the power transmission in non-grid-connected wind power system is brought out.

articleTitle: A dynamically balanced non-grid battery-less wind energy system
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: This paper introduced a dynamically balanced non-grid battery-less (DBNGB) wind energy system with wind energy in prior and grid energy for a supplement. And it emphasized the technology of power electronic control which is viewed as the hinge of non-grid wind energy application, and this new mode has concluded a set of solutions by applying it to an oil field in east part of China and several enterprises and proposed a brand new orientation for the wind energy application.

articleTitle: Study on the index system of large-scale non-grid-connected wind power suitable industry
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: This article mainly expounds on the connotation of index evaluation system of the large-scale, non-grid-connected wind power industry and its construction principles, determines the index levels of the system and the scientific significance and calculation method of each index, and conducts case analysis in accordance with the constructed index system. The index system is divided into two levels: (1) the first level includes macro index groups in four aspects, respectively reflecting the characteristics of economy, society, environment, and random fluctuation of wind power; (2) the second level reflects specific index construction of each macro index group in the first level. The weight of an index at each level in index system is eventually determined by level analysis through classifying each index, establishing a multi-level structure, building a paired comparison matrix, and through many rounds of comprehensive analysis in accordance with CR testing. The method and the process of weight determination is objective, rigorous, and scientific. A comprehensive evaluation model is built on according to the intrinsic link between indexes, and, finally, a scientific, reasonable, and improved system of comprehensive index evaluation is formed. The index system shall observe combination of the current interests with long-term interests, economic, and ecological benefits with social benefits and static analysis with dynamic analysis and take account of guidance, systematic, scientific and adaptive principles in the process of its establishment.

articleTitle: Study on the non-coal high-energy-consumption chlor-alkali industry layout in China based on the development of the non-grid-connected wind power industry
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: The chlor-alkali chemical industry has high energy consumption and is facing a developmental bottleneck presently due to a shortage of energy. Realizing the coupling space layout between the large-scale non-grid-connected wind power industry and the chlor-alkali chemical industry, and establishing the non-coal high-energy-consumption chlor-alkali chemical industrial bases have the vital significance to the comprehensive utilization of wind energy and the sustainable development of the chlor-alkali chemical industry. Based on determining the spatial distribution of China's large-scale non-grid-connected wind power industry by using development data of the social economy and of the wind power industry as of 2006, this paper studies the anticipated spatial layout frame of the non-coal high-energy-consumption chlor-alkali chemical industry in China by 2020 through overall consideration of the current situation and the planned objectives of the chlor-alkali chemical industry. The study shows that in 2020 China will form nine non-coal high-energy-consumption chlor-alkali chemical industrial bases including Jiangsu, Shandong, Zhejiang, Liaoning, Xinjiang, Inner Mongolia, Shanxi, Ningxia and Qinghai, which can generate 1 713.94times108 kilowatt hours of electricity, save 2149.84times104 tons of raw coal, reduce dust emission by 202.82times104 tons, reduce carbon dioxide emissions by 4056.31times104 tons, reduce nitrogen oxides emission by 20.28times104 tons, and reduce sulfur dioxide emissions by 32.45times104 tons, which are produced from burning coal, and thereby improve both economic efficiency and environment benefits.

articleTitle: A numerical simulation of flow around a wind turbine airfoil based on transition model
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: The laminar-to-turbulent transition is one of the most complex but important flows. In order to deeply apprehend the wind turbine airfoil flow characteristics and the transition phenomenon, a two-equation transition model is applied in this article to simulate the flow over a wind turbine S814 airfoil. Typical angle of attack and both steady and unsteady transition models are tried. The predictions are compared with the experimental data of the National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL) and the simulation results of fully turbulent SST model. The analysis has been shown that, transition model can capture the phenomena of transition and flow separation more effectively. Under certain working conditions, the transition model predicts the lift coefficient and drag coefficient more accurately than a full turbulence model. The weak point is that the transition model requires a much longer computing time.

articleTitle: The cascade buck-boost PFC converter with soft switching
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: A new cascade buck-boost topology with passive lossless snubber is proposed in this paper, it has been successfully used in PFC circuit of high voltage system. Switching losses and EMI noises are reduced by restricting di/dt of the diode reverse recovery current and dv/dt of IGBT collector-emitter voltage. The IGBT in the buck circuit operates at ZVS turn-off and ZCS turn-on. The freewheeling diode is also commutated with ZVS. An APFC prototype has been built in the laboratory to demonstrate the effects of the circuit. Power factor of this 380 VAC/600 W proof-of-prototype is 0.98 and less than 11% THD can be achieved.

articleTitle: Control of offshore wind turbine simulators for real time using layering models
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: Offshore wind energy has become an increasingly attractive option due to the enormous energy potential associated with the vast offshore areas. The investigation of offshore wind turbines characterized by large-scale involves high performance wind turbine simulator, especially in the case of the development of optimal control strategy. Because of the increasing rotor size and the spatial load variations along the blade, it is necessary to develop new wind speed model, mathematical model of blades and control strategy. In this paper, we propose three-dimensional wind speed model with height according to von Karman power spectrum as the input of the simulator, assuming that the wind model undergoes the same turbulence, which makes it possible to choose correlation wind sources. We use layering technique on the basis of quantizing vortex to receive layering wind speeds as the input of layering mathematical model of the huge blades. These models could be implemented on the structure of the simulator to develop the new control strategy for real time.

articleTitle: A study of wind turbine blades optimization based on a rotational speed control model
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: The National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL) Phase II - IV wind turbine rotors<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup> were used as the original research subjects in this article. In this paper, the numerical simulation method and business software FLUENT were used. The aerodynamic performances of different fixed-pitch, horizontal-axis wind turbine rotors were obtained through numerical computation. A rotational speed control model was given by direct calculation on the aerodynamic parameters of straight blades. As in the previous model, it required the wind turbine rotational speed be changed as little as possible in consideration of the life expectancy improvement and dynamo size reduction. Then, numerical simulation was used in one twisted wind turbine blade, three simple twist-oriented corrected models were acquired by flow-field analysis and simplified blade element theory application. Certain improvements in the wind turbine aerodynamic performances were obtained by contrasts of P-V curves and rotational speed model with original twisted wind turbine blade.

articleTitle: A new approach of coordinated development of large-scale non-grid-connected wind power and energy-intensive industries in Xinjiang
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: Xinjiang is one of the areas with the most abundant wind power energy in China. The latest statistics show that the wind energy resources reserve in Xinjiang currently ranks first in the country. Xinjiang, the site of the first wind power station in the country, was established in 1989. Xinjiang has always been and continues to be a leader in development of wind power in terms of the installed capacity and speed of development. The last two years, however, the wind power industry in Xinjiang has gradually begun to slow down its pace of development. The reason for the downturn in development is that economical development in Xinjiang is slow and the demand for electricity is not great. Also the cost of wind power is higher than that of thermal power, and grid wind power is facing a number of technical bottlenecks. Furthermore, the policy governing the wind power industry is one of deficiency. For these reasons, this paper proposes a new approach that large-scale, non-grid-connected wind power be applied directly to energy-intensive industries and suggests implementing the strategy of coordinated development between non-grid-connected wind power and the energy-intensive industries. In order to reach the goal, a three-step measurement for wind power development in Xinjiang is also proposed: (1) give priority to the development of large-scale non-grid-connected wind power; (2) develop grid wind power when giving priority to the large-scale, non-grid-connected wind power; and (3) implement strategic transfer to the southeast coastal area relying on technical superiority.

articleTitle: The estimation of wind power resources in China
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: This paper selects the data of energy consumption and economic output of different provinces from 1997 to 2006, constructs the regression equation between these 2 factors, and makes use of the equivalent substituted method. Based on the methods mentioned above, this paper estimates the equivalent value of coal, crude oil and electricity to the actual development of China's wind energy resource reserves per hour, and the estimations are 527.11 times, 1195.20 times, and 5745.82 times the National GDP of 2006.

articleTitle: Research on the development policy of non-carbon energy-consuming industry using large-scale non-grid-connected wind power
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: This paper proposes that the inevitable direction for wind power development in China is large-scale non-grid-connected wind power system because of its importance for speeding up the development of non-carbon energy-consuming industries. The challenges and urgency for constituting the wind power development policy in China are expounded after summarizing domestic and foreign policy experience in developing wind power. Furthermore, a basic policy framework for developing non-carbon energy-consuming industries using large-scale non-grid-connected wind power is built.

articleTitle: Calculation and study of two-dimensional parameter local bifurcation boundary in wind power system stability model based on continuation method
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: In order to reveal the mechanism of voltage stability in wind power system and influence to its voltage stability with parameters changing, for limitations of present study about wind power system voltage stability based on bifurcation theory, two-parameter bifurcation analysis were detailed. With the help of ideas that conventional electric power system to calculate the two-dimensional parameter bifurcation boundary, the node voltage two-dimensional saddle-node bifurcation boundary of wind power system was calculated by using inject active power of wind farm, SVC parameters B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</inf> and K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf> as bifurcation control parameters. And on the basis of this in-depth analysis, the laws that parameters affecting the wind power system voltage stability were obtained.

articleTitle: Estimation of monthly mean hourly diffuse solar radiation
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: Measured hourly diffuse solar radiation data of Zhengzhou in 2004 were analyzed in this work. The solar model proposed by Liu and Jordan was used to estimate the monthly mean hourly diffuse solar radiation data at Zhengzhou in 2004. Comparison between estimated and measured values of the hourly diffuse solar radiation showed that Liu & Jordan model can predict the measured data with good accuracy during 8:00-17:00.

articleTitle: Research on integrated process of large-scale non-grid-connected wind power and coal-to-ethylene glycol
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: The contribution rate of wind power on the grid is difficult to beyond 10%. The wind-powered generator increases the complexity and the manufacturing costs for meeting the requirements of power grid, which limits the applications of large-scale wind power. The coal-to-ethylene-glycol (EG) process is an important technology route for decreasing oil-importing, but release a large number of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. Integrated process of large-scale non-grid-connected wind power and coal-to-EG "grafts" the wind power on the traditional coal chemical industry to avoid the bottleneck issue of wind power. We found the integrated process can reduce manufacturing costs of wind farms and reduce the CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions, and at the same time increase output of ethylene glycol if using smaller air separation unit and CO conversion devices. The integrated process will greatly make ldquogreenrdquo coal chemical industry possible and achieve optimization of efficiency, economic and environmental benefits, as well as provide new practical technologies of energy-saving and consumption-reducing to substitute oil strategy for China.

articleTitle: Harmonic magnetomotive force and static-dynamic characteristics of the 6/3-phase dual stator-winding induction generator
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: The usual dual-stator winding induction generator (DWIG) is composed of 3-phase power winding and 3-phase control winding, defined as 3/3-phase DWIG. The power winding has only three phases, and connects to a rectifier load, which results in larger harmonic magnetomotive force (MMF) in the generator. In order to overcome this problem and improve the performance of the DWIG system, the power winding of 3/3-phase DWIG is converted from three phases to six phases. A novel 6/3-phase DWIG with six phase power windings and three phase control windings is proposed. The six power windings of it are divided to two Y windings shifted by 30deg electrical angle. In this paper, in order to further study the static and dynamic characteristics of 6/3-phase DWIG system with a rectifier load, harmonic MMF in generator are analyzed in detail. The corresponding relationship between the harmonic current and harmonic MMF is achieved. Based on these, the model of a 600 V/18 kW 6/3-phase DWIG system is built-up. The simulation and experiment results indicate that the 6/3-phase DWIG system has excellent performance over the wide speed rang and is suitable for the application of wind generation.

articleTitle: Research on the bi-directional AC-DC converter for the large-scale non-grid-connected wind power application
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: In recent years, space vector pulse-width modulation (SVPWM) technique obtains widespread application in AC modulation because of its high utilization of dc bus, fast dynamic response and easier digital realization. The paper focuses on the bi-dirction control methodology based on a 50 kW three-phase AC-DC PWM rectifier of high power factor. Active and reactive current are controlled respectively in d-q rotating coordinatce system and unity power factor rectifier can be achieved. First SVPWM control principle is analyzed and the control schematic of the entire system is provided. Next simulation model of SVPWM is obtained using MATLAB/SIMULINK. Finally simulation results are also provided.

articleTitle: Technique analysis of off-grid wind power used for aluminum electrolysis
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: Two months of basic data which are in March 2008 and April 2008 about wind speed and its relevant output power of single wind driven generator have been selected and analyzed. A special situation that two wind driven generators supplied power for three aluminum electrolysis pots has been analyzed technically. In the analysis, a whole day has been divided into two periods which are day time and night time, different power supply mode will be selected according to particular cases.

articleTitle: Study on link distribution of the large-scale non-grid-connected wind power industry and the lower carbon colored metallurgy industry
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: China has beneficial conditions for developing wind power. The wind energy resources are rich terms of exploitable capacity. Under the restraint of the society's goal for resource conservation and environmental friendliness, the development and construction of large-scale non-grid-connected wind electricity will without a doubt have significant influence in the Chinese electricity industry. As the heavy energy consuming industry, the high consumption of energy industry- the colored metallurgy industry is also the fundamental industry for China economic development. When the industry scale is gradually expanding, the structural contradiction becomes more prominent, in particular, the resource and environmental pressures placed in industry development. Obviously, this energy issues threatens the sustainable development of the colored metallurgy industry. So, by combining the development of this industry with the construction of large-scale non-grid-connected wind electricity, a link emerges between distribution of wind power and the colored metallurgy industry will help. Speeding up the construction of the wind power-colored metallurgy industry bases has important meaning. By analyzing the influencing factors and the layout of wind farms and the colored metallurgy industry, this paper establishes the basic research frame for wind electricity industry layout with the consideration of colored metallurgy industry. Taking the province territory scale as the example, the paper discusses the link layout of the bases of the national wind electricity industry and colored metallurgy industry in China. We identified six provinces that are suitable for building first-level wind power and colored metallurgy industry bases and other seven provinces that can be built as the second-level wind power and colored metallurgy industry bases. This is a preliminary study and more study will be needed.

Author Keywords: Large-scale non-grid-connected wind power industry base

articleTitle: Three-level reversible converter for large-scale non-grid-connected wind power system
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: The Diode-clamped three-level reversible converter is researched in this paper. The converter can operate in four quadrants with power flow in bi-direction. The low frequency model of the converter is built. The mode-switching between the rectification and inversion is analyzed in detail with the vector relationship between voltage and current derived. The control for rectification and inversion operation is proposed, respectively. Experimental results are given to verify the analysis and design at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: “Green” integrated system: Non-grid-connected wind power and coal-to-methanol
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: Wind energy is a mature technology that has promising future in development and utilization of renewable energy sources, but the contribution rate of wind power on the grid is difficult to reach beyond 10% due to the high randomicity of wind. Coal-to-methanol process as the representative of the modern coal chemical industry is the important strategic alternatives of petrochemical product in application, but it will emit a considerable amount of carbon dioxide in the production process. A new integrated system which combines coal-to-methanol with wind power is proposed in this paper. In this system, wind power is used to electrolyze water for producing H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. The O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> is fed to the gasifier as gasification agent. The H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> is mixed with the CO-rich gas to adjust the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/CO to an appropriate ratio for methanol synthesis. In comparison with conventional coal-to-methanol system, the proposed system omits the expensive and energy-consuming Air-Separation-Unit (ASU) and greatly reduces the water gas shift process, which brings both advantages in the utilization of all raw materials and significant reduction of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission. This system will be attractive in the regions of China with abundant wind and coal resources.

articleTitle: Predictive analysis and basic judgment of development targets in China's wind power industry
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: This paper presents the basic principles and the starting point which can help us to set goals for wind power industry development. After analyzing the existing development goals of national wind power industry, this paper finds that the national planned target for wind power is too low, and the actual installed capacity of wind power has doubled compared to the national planned target of 2010. Besides, the planning goals of every provinces are different, which are high on the whole, and there is a phenomenon of target comparison. This paper predicates the scientific goals of the development of China's wind power industry by using accumulation value method, local growth rate method, analogy growth rate method, GM (1,1) model and so on. The goal is that the installed capacity of China's wind power will come to 16.33 million kW by 2010, 41.72 million kW by 2015, and 100.21 million kW by 2020, which accounts for 8.35% of total installed electricity capacity within the same period. It is also estimated that China's installed capacity of wind power will account for 8.15% of global total installed capacity of wind power industry by 2020, and the wind power industry will step into a stage of rapid development.

articleTitle: Wind power industry policies and proposals of investment and finance of China
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: Mankind is facing growing energy crisis and environmental deterioration dramatically. So finding new sources of energy has become a top priority. Wind energy is a clean renewable energy. The development and broad use of wind energy have great potential. At present, wind power generation technology is becoming more mature and the wind power industry development grows fast. The major significance of development of wind power is analyzed in this paper. The development of China's wind power industry needs investment in all aspects in terms of finance. By studying the strategic choice of the development of China's wind power industry, its investment and financing situation, we proposed strategies and recommendation from the aspect of wind power industry investment and finance in this paper.

articleTitle: Offshore wind farm construction platform jack-up control system
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: Based on the requirements of the offshore wind farm construction, an intelligent remote control system has been proposed for jacking-up offshore platform. The system consists of a wireless LAN, a master control system, an intelligent node control system, and front sensors. The master control system is composed of a master control decision-making expert system, a malfunction diagnosis and disposal decision-making expert system, and database system, a virtual reality display system, and a wireless LAN system. The intelligent node control system consists of a control decision-making expert system, a jacking control system, a locking control system, a malfunction diagnosis system, executing controllers, status sensors, a database system, a pier-side control interface, and wireless LAN system. This remote control system enables a real-time analysis of the status of the platform, self adjusting of the platform, and memorizing previous decision for a better efficient control. This system supports independent execution with fault diagnosis & recovery ability. So it is recommended because it meets the requirements of offshore platform of wind farm construction.

articleTitle: Research of the construction of non-grid-connected wind power industrial agglomeration areas in the Bohai-Rim Region based onGIS
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: The Bohai-Rim region, including three Provinces of Liaoning, Hebei, and Shandong, and two cities of Beijing and Tianjin are discussed. In accordance with the endowment of wind power, the type of land cover and indicators of the built and planned construction of wind farms, and taking 10km times 10km as the basic spatial unit, this paper evaluates the suitability of the construction of non-grid-connected wind power industrial agglomeration in Bohai-Rim region by the approach of grid analysis, and identifies 5 levels as highly suitable areas, relatively suitable areas, moderately suitable areas, inferiorly suitable areas and unsuitable areas. Based on the research above, this paper discusses the development objectives of the 0.185times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> kW wind energy capacity of the Bohai-Rim region, and the corresponding objectives of energy saving and pollution emission reduction. Besides, this paper puts forward the assumption of constructing the non-grid-connected wind power industrial agglomeration and high-energy-consumption and low-coal industrial agglomeration in Bohai-Rim region. These agglomeration regions include the non-grid-connected wind power industrial agglomeration area of the middle-south of Liaoning province and the Liaoning peninsula, the non-grid-connected wind power industrial agglomeration area of the Shandong peninsula and the non-grid-connected wind power industrial agglomeration area of the northwest of Hebei province. Finally, this paper discusses the strategies to construct the non-grid-connected wind power industrial agglomeration in the areas mentioned above.

articleTitle: On site sodium manufacturing for energy storage with offshore wind power and seawater
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: Sodium metal reacts with water violently and generates a huge amount of hydrogen. Sodium metal has the role as a hydrogen storage material. The fossil fuel and nuclear fuel are deposited only in a limited region in the world and reserves are limited, whereas sodium exists plentifully as a salt in seawater and exists abundantly as a rock salt on the continents. Sodium (specific gravity, 0.971) is lighter than water and is stored safely in kerosene for electric power. The solution can then be transported to a location and with the addition of water can instantaneously generate a large amount of hydrogen for power generation.

articleTitle: Semi-variance of risk decision-making for purchasing electricity in multi-market
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: Aiming at the choices and risk management that electricity purchasers will face to purchase power in four markets under the framework of the electricity market. This paper, which uses semi-variance to measure risk, has established two risk decision-making models based on restrictive and non-restrictive buy /sell through risks measured by semi-variance. Meanwhile, it proposes to minimize the risks on the basis of historic data and practical statistical genetic algorithms under the premise of benefit guarantee.

articleTitle: Research on application of non-grid-connected wind power in less developed areas
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: Distributed generation has become a new research focus in power system worldwide. Non-grid-connected wind power, as a special kind of distributed generation, develops along environmental sustainable development and technological advancement. Non-grid-connected wind power system will provide a road to diversification of wind power utilization. This article analyzes how the wind power is utilized in less developed areas, and combines the conditions for development and application of non-grid-connected wind power. The opinion is then put forward for less developed areas with good wind force (annual average wind velocity above 4 meters per minute, none hurricane possibility). These areas have no access to power grid with insufficient electricity supply, diseconomy to do grid extension, and so on. These areas are suitable for non-grid-connected wind power application. Developing non-grid-connected wind power in less developed areas will cultivate a new economic growth and benefit environments.

articleTitle: An intelligent inspection and control system for the single flow Zn/Ni battery
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: To meet the needs of research and practical application of single flow Zn/Ni battery for non-grid-connection wind power system, the intelligent inspection and control system was developed. Its design principle, hardware system assembly and monitoring system functions were introduced. The intelligent inspection and control system has abundant functions such as user safety management, working instance real-time display, charge and discharge control, battery protective of excessive charge or discharge, history curves, data report forms, system alarms and so on. It has been applied to the 100 W single flow Zn/Ni battery online.

articleTitle: Development of a non-grid-connected wind power large-scale hydrogen production experimental System
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: A hydrogen production experimental system is developed to verify the theory of the non-grid-connected wind power. This experimental system analyzes the new type of wind turbine and its characteristics, the integrated control strategy, and the system feasibility and controllability so as to fully reveal the basic rules of non-grid-connected wind power system. These practices demonstrated the reasonable structure, convenient expansion and full functions of this experimental system.

articleTitle: Research on constructing large scale non-grid-connected wind power industrial system
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: Application of large-scale non-grid-connected wind power is a way to develop wind power in multi-direction. However constructing this industrial system is a critical aspect of multidirectional development of wind power. The system contains a series of industries that have forward, backward or adjacent linkages. The system is a modern comprehensive industrial system which is related to three strata of industries.

articleTitle: Blade design for a horizantal axis variable speed wind-driven generator
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: First of all, blade element theory is presented in this paper. Based on this theory, the power outputs of the wind turbine are calculated from aerodynamic parameters of airfoil. With these, pitch control concept and speed control concept are presented. Then, different pitch angle distributions along the radius and corresponding power outputs are analyzed. A blade for a variable speed wind-driven generator can be designed to decrease the speed variation range through designing the pitch angle of the cross section of the blade properly, on the condition that the power output is stable from rated wind speed to shut down wind speed.

articleTitle: A FSI model for non-grid-connected wind turbine Rotor
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: Recent research shows fluid-structure interaction (FSI) problem becomes a key issue in the development of non-grid-connected wind turbines. In order to understand the mechanisms of FSI problem, this paper develops a numerical model based on boundary element method and finite element method. The boundary element method is used to calculate the unsteady aerodynamic forces acting on blades of the wind turbines. The finite element method is used to calculate the deformation and vibrations of the blade. The results show good agreement with the experiment data and prove that this model is suitable for understanding the FSI problem of the wind turbine.

articleTitle: Investment opportunities and risk countermeasure analysis of non-grid-connected wind power industry
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: With the global financial crisis, the new energy industry is brewing new economic growth points, as well as strategic commanding point of a new round of international competition. The development of large-scale non-grid-connected wind power application techniques has been breaking the bottleneck of traditional grid-connected technology. In terms of the wind power proportion in the entire power grid, this development has significantly reduced the failure rate of wind turbine, as well as avoiding the impact load on the power grid. Based on the analysis of non-grid-connected wind power investment fields, market prospects, government policy, technical and risk countermeasure, this article explains the investment value and competitive advantage of non-grid-connected wind power applications in the development of new energy industry.

Author Keywords: a breakthrough of wind power industry

articleTitle: Anodic gas behavior of aluminum electrolysis with high current density
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: In order to adapt the characteristics of wind power, we investigated the anode process with high current density. A liquid fluctuation testing system of aluminum electrolysis was designed. It was used to test the electrolyte liquid fluctuation conditions in the electrolysis course with differently shaped anodes and different current densities; the effect of electrolyte fluctuation frequency and extent of the bubbling behavior of anodic gas were analyzed. Bath voltage fluctuation conditions in the electrolysis course with differently shaped anodes and different current densities were tested, and the effects of bath voltage fluctuation frequency and voltage drop on the bubbling behavior of anodic gas were analyzed.

articleTitle: Study of distributing a bio-inspired optimization strategy generator in energy-saving power dispatching
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: At present, the energy-saving and environmental protection dispatching policy is proposed by our country for all power plants, while multiple energy-saving and environmental protection indexes bring forth a typical non-linear multiple-target decision-making problem, for which nothing can be done by way of the traditional control method. Thus, the paper proposes a bionics optimization strategy generator to construct the power generation decision-making information network of power plant sets and supports a kind of optimized bionics hardware module based on a hybrid algorithm of the ant colony system - the design train of thought for strategy generation.

articleTitle: Wind energy exploitation and hydrogen production bases construction applying non-grid-connected wind power in Jiangsu coastal areas
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: Energy consumption is increasing dramatically nowadays and the gap in the power supply is enlarging. Current energy consumption and environmental pollution call for improving the layout of energy consumption, protecting the environment, and large-scale application of renewable energies. Wind energy is abundant in Jiangsu (especially in Jiangsu's coastal areas), which provides large space for wind power development. Application of large-scale, non-grid-connected wind power is one of the ways to develop wind power. In this paper, author analyzes distribution and exploitation of wind resources in Jiangsu's coastal areas, studies the industrial chain of ldquoapplying non-grid-connected wind power to large scale hydrogen productionrdquo based on non-grid-connected wind power theory, and puts forward some suggestions for constructing hydrogen production bases in Jiangsu's coastal areas.

articleTitle: Research on the non-grid-connected wind power distribution network with the ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: The ant colony algorithm has been successfully used to solve NP problem in many fields. In this paper, a new method to solve power network planning is presented. For a given power network model, this algorithm will find out the best routing path only if it exits. Some examples show that this algorithm is more intelligent and efficient than other ones.

articleTitle: Research on innovation alliance of non-grid-connected wind power production and research based on “triple helix” model
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: Development of non-grid-connected wind power is an important guarantee to solve the problem that large-scale wind power encountered, that is, hard to achieve and to realize the strategic objectives of diversified application of wind power. Construction of innovation alliance of non-grid-connected wind power production and research can promote application and industrialization of technological innovation and non-wind wind power project, its research networks for new concepts, technology, information, etc. This paper explored non-grid-connected wind power innovation and industry-university research alliance which forms a "triple helix." This triple Helix is composed of scientific research institutions, enterprises and government, which should be supported by Government and its policy guidance. Government supporting of the non-grid-connected wind power production and research innovation and the development can help with the building of coalition and at the same time encourage the following activities: 1) create a favorable environment for cooperation; 2) set up special funds for technological innovation; 3) provide financial protection of production and research of innovation alliance; 4) attach importance to common technical research and development and promotion.

articleTitle: Research on the wind/coal multi-energy system
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: Decided by the actual utilization conditions of energy and resource in China, wind and coal resources will play an increasingly important role in the sustainable development of energy and become one of important development trends in coal chemical energy. This paper analyzes the wind/coal multi-energy system and its characteristics. The system "grafts" wind power on the traditional coal chemical industry through the process of water-electrolytic hydrogen production, and predominates in producing clean energy and alternative petrochemical products, combines wind power with coal chemical processes, MTO, etc., to form an integrated energy and chemical system. It not only avoid the bottleneck of wind power grid connected and makes full use of wind energy resources, but also significantly reduces the environmental pollution of coal chemical, especially the emissions of carbon dioxide, and realizes the best benefits of enterprise, economy, and society; this has great significance for reducing imported oil and protecting national energy security.

articleTitle: Research on construction of non-grid-connected wind power electricity industrial bases in the urban agglomerations of the Yangtze River Delta area in China
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: The Yangtze River Delta, to which this paper refers, includes Shanghai, Zhejiang Province, and Jiangsu Province, where the wind energy resources are abundant and electric power resources are limited. Hence, there will be a bright future for the development of renewable, green energy based on wind power electricity in the Yangtze River Delta area. On the basis of summarizing the total quantity, the construction conditions and prospects of coastal wind power electricity for exploitation in the Yangtze River Delta area, this paper puts forward the following plan: 16 wind farms with an installed capacity of 1200times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> kilowatts will be located along the coast of the Yangtze River Delta. These wind farms will be integrated into 3 non-grid-connected wind power electricity industrial bases, which are the bases respectively in the northern Jiangsu coastal area, the southern Jiangsu, the Shanghai coastal area and the northern Zhejiang coastal area. This paper brings forth corresponding thinking of industrial layout to each base and measures taken to exploit wind energy resources, and establishing a non-grid-connected wind power industrial base is finally proposed.

articleTitle: Design of non-grid-connected wind power simulation system based on CMM/CMMI
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: Non-grid-connected wind power system is a complex system, which includes several subsystems such as wind turbine subsystem, non-grid-connected electric generator subsystems, non-grid-connected wind power control subsystem, gas-solid coupling vibration subsystems, and high energy-consuming special load subsystems. It is a multi-objective, multi-factor, higher-order non-linear dynamics of large-scale system. The non-grid-connected wind power system simulation is an experimental method based on the operation model of non-grid wind power system. This paper analyzes the importance and processes of the non-grid-connected wind power system simulation, and presents the process of a CMM / CMMI software development model. In the end, applications of the CMM / CMMI in the non-grid wind power simulation system design are discussed.

articleTitle: Study on China’s wind power industry policy and investment and financing
publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: Within the context of the global environmental crisis and the bio-energy crisis, countries across the world are all actively developing wind power equipment and exploring their own wind resources. China is rich in wind resources, and its wind power industry is now developing quickly; however, there are some drawbacks in the wind power industry policy, resulting in lagging efficiency for wind power industry development. By briefly introducing the development of wind power in foreign countries, this paper introduces the current situation and polices of China's wind power, discusses the deficiencies and shortcomings in its development by descriptions on it, and makes several policy suggestions. This paper focuses on the policies and channels of investment and financing in the wind power industry, discusses the current investment and financing policies on China's wind power industry and further discusses the ways to improve it. It discusses the channels and development directions of investment and financing from the domestic and international perspectives, and makes several suggestions on the issues such as investment and financial credit.

publicationTitle: 2009 World Non-Grid-Connected Wind Power and Energy Conference
abstract: The following topics are dealt with : wind power industry and policy; wind power system; nongrid-connected wind power; offshore wind power farms; and wind power diversification application.
